Powhatan Courthouse No Drop (RABA)

Powhatan, VA · Flatrock · Road

No-dropBeginner friendly

Powhatan Courthouse No Drop (RABA) is a road group ride in Powhatan, VA. It rolls every Sunday at 9:00 am from Citizens Bank & Trust, Flatrock. About 28–33 miles, c/D pace. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: c/D pace. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Powhatan Courthouse No Drop (RABA) group ride

A true no-drop club ride west of Richmond. About 31 miles on low-traffic roads with a store stop halfway. The leader's line: print the cue sheet or follow me, I will not let you out of my sight. Text or call the leader a day or two ahead to confirm.
